method: Six alternating pack CLI activations (real nested compositor reload/check), then three fresh full production-shell starts until Configuration Loaded, with 10 ms polling. Isolated IPC/XDG roots/private D-Bus. Baseline copies task-start source; beforeReview copies the exact pre-review source hash; new copies final source. Dependencies/assets/caches warm; this measures configuration loading, not first-pixel presentation or user-desktop startup. No network/device actions. Old service writes geometry; new writes colors only.
attributionLimit: The new full-shell performance copy can include concurrent launcher edits. Configuration Loaded samples are observational and do not isolate the cost of these eight theme fixes. Theme CLI switch checks do not execute launcher QML.
